newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK FOREX CLUB ELECTS NEW BOARD OF DIRECTORS.
newsitem.headline: GREEK FOREX CLUB ELECTS NEW BOARD OF DIRECTORS.

text.p: Forex Club Hellas held its annual
general assembly at Titania Hotel in central Athens on Monday
and elected its new board of directors, dealers told Reuters.
The new members are:
Vassilis Dagritzikos, state Commercial Bank of Greece
George Georgiou, Bayerische Vereinsbank
Antonis Gounaris, Citibank
Charalambos Kolezas, Bank of America
Krystallo Mirchou, Bank of Greece
Dimitris Papaioannou, American Express
Alexander Papandreou, state National Bank of Greece
Konstandinos Kamaris, Midland Bank
Athanassios Hasapis, NatWest
The main message that came out of the meeting was the need
for greater participation by the new members of the Club to make
it more effective in promoting the professional interests of its
members in the future, dealers said.
The Association Cambiste Hellenique is the professional
association of foreign exchange, money market and securities
traders.
--Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
